gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients must have radiologically and histologically confirmed diagnosis of newly diagnosed glioblastoma

candidate_evidence.quote: [DEVICE] 3 Tesla magnetic resonance imaging: High resolution structural imaging (contrast-enhanced T1-weighted image, T2-weighted image, Fluid-attenuated inversion recovery)

This clinical trial studies advanced MR imaging techniques in measuring early response of standard treatment may become predictors of long-term treatment response in patients with newly diagnosed glioblastomas.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients must have radiologically and histologically confirmed diagnosis of newly diagnosed glioblastoma

role_evidence.quote: Patients scheduled for standard therapy (6 weeks radiation treatment (RT) \~ 60 Gy, plus temozolomide 75 mg/m\^2 during 6 week RT, and followed routine monthly temozolomide therapy)

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, GBM standard of care

role_evidence.quote: perfusion (using DCE-MRI and DSC-MRI with IV administration of gadolinium-containing contrast agent)

coder_notes: Imaging study (Phase NA, devices only). Temozolomide is standard therapy every patient receives (not a registered intervention).
